How our offers and bookings work

Every package above is a starting point: dates, hotels and activities are adjusted to your family, and the final price is fixed before you pay. Prices are per person in a family of four sharing two rooms, excluding international flights, and vary with the season.

What is included

  • Hotels (4-star by default, 5-star on request) with breakfast.
  • Private car with driver for airport transfers, city tours and day trips.
  • Arabic- or English-speaking guide on tour days.
  • Entrance tickets listed in the program, booked in advance.
  • 24/7 WhatsApp support from our local office.

Not included: international flights (we can book them for you), visas, meals other than breakfast, and optional activities.

Popular packages by destination

  • Kazakhstan: 6-day Almaty tour and 7-day Almaty and Astana program.
  • Russia: 7-day Moscow program, 10-day Moscow and St. Petersburg and the complete 12-day Russia program; see also early-booking discounts for Russia.
  • Poland: Poland tour programs and hotel reservations in Krakow and Zakopane.
  • Uzbekistan: 7-day Silk Road program.
  • China: travel programs in China for families and traders.

Booking steps

  1. Choose a package or describe your trip on WhatsApp +7 706 400 7561.
  2. Receive a day-by-day program and a fixed quote within 24 hours.
  3. Pay a deposit to confirm; the balance is due before departure.
  4. Receive hotel vouchers, tickets and your guide's contact details.

Frequently asked questions

Can we change dates after booking?
Yes, subject to hotel and ticket availability; changes more than 14 days before departure are usually free.

Do children pay the full price?
Children under 12 sharing their parents' room get reduced rates; infants under 2 travel free.

Which payment methods do you accept?
Bank transfer and card payment links; for Russia we also arrange local payments on your behalf, since international cards do not work there.

Do you help with visas?
Yes. We prepare the hotel confirmations and itineraries required for Schengen (Poland) applications, and for Russian e-visa or Chinese visa applications where a visa is still needed (most Gulf citizens now enter Russia and China visa-free).
